feature_schema.name: compute_features_v1
feature_schema.description: Morgan fingerprint (2048 bits, radius=2) + 9 normalized RDKit descriptors (LogP, TPSA, MW, HAcceptors, HDonors, RotBonds, RingCount, FractionCSP3, NumHeavyAtoms). See src/sisyphus/descriptors.py::compute_features.

retrained_reason: Small/noisy dataset; R^2 < 0. Pipeline defaults to RBP=1.0 when prediction falls outside [0.1, 3.0]. See adme.py:138 warning.
